statement: The AOC knowledge pack target fingerprint is computed with the MPB managed runtime mod excluded so patch installation does not change compatibility.
The AOC pack source includes deterministic static extraction records from local mod jar assets and data resources.
The AOC pack source includes deterministic records for runtime-affecting config, datapack, script, resourcepack, texturepack, shaderpack, and generated cache inputs.
The AOC pack source includes recipe graph records converted from local JSON recipe resources.
The AOC pack source includes tag lookup records converted from local JSON tag resources.
Runtime lab experiments and real Prism client validation are documented as release-blocking gates when the Minecraft client is not running.
